title: Rabbah bar Livai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Pesachim 40b and Avodah Zarah 65b he raised an objection to Rava; Rava was embarrassed and retracted.

In Pesachim 110a they said that Rava bar Livai was harmed (because he drank in pairs), and Rava said this was because he had objected to him in the lecture. Hyman records two halakhot from him: in Yevamot 12b Rabbah bar Livai said, “It has a limit; before this time she does not conceive,” etc.; and in Niddah 46b he said, “Her husband annuls for her at every moment.”

notes.text: The supplied מתבערת differs from saved Davidson Yevamot 12b’s מתעברת, “she does not conceive.” The English follows the conception sense; no physical letter history is asserted. Rava in the supplied Pesachim episode is retained against Rabbah in the other halakhot.
